claims: Venezuela defeated Italy 4-2 on March 16, 2026, in a World Baseball Classic (WBC) semifinal at loanDepot Park in Miami.
Venezuela advanced to their first-ever WBC final.
A three-run rally in the seventh inning overcame a 2-0 Italy lead.
The three-run rally was powered by RBI singles from Ronald Acuña Jr., Maikel Garcia, and Luis Arraez.
Venezuela used six relievers to throw 7.2 scoreless innings.
Italy entered the semifinal with a 5-0 record.
Venezuela faces the United States in the final on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The New York Times says the 2-0 deficit was set early on by Italy's RBIs from J.J. D'Orazio and Dante Nori
